about.summary: IT and Digital professional with 4+ years of experience across web development, IT operations, and content creation.
about.detail: Built a strong foundation in e-commerce at Daraz (Alibaba Group), contributing to platform UI/UX improvements and regional UAT coordination. Currently working in the financial services sector managing IT infrastructure, vendor relations, KYC operations, and day-to-day digital activities — equally comfortable handling a technical issue and a creative brief. Currently completing a BSc (Hons) in Computing at Wrexham University.

bullets: Managed the end-to-end KYC process — reviewing applications, verifying documents, authenticating clients via video call.
Coordinated with vendors on domain/DNS, Google Workspace admin and endpoint security; maintained the company website and internal IT hardware.
Directed and produced business podcast episodes end to end, from shoot to edit.
Designed all company promotional material — posters, flyers, digital assets — and ran social media content end to end.
Maintained and optimized the company website and corporate social platforms.
Designed promotional posters, flyers and leaflets for business use.
Supported IT infrastructure audits and internal network troubleshooting.
Oversaw website/app changes, contributing to a 20% lift in user engagement and 15% gain in functional efficiency.
Tracked UI/UX performance and analyzed 10+ homepage modules daily for optimization.
Coordinated regional UAT and onsite project initiatives, lifting operational efficiency by 10%.
Ran mega sale campaigns — 11.11, Avurudu and seasonal promos — with Design and Merchandising teams.
Built and published campaign pages in the Daraz CMS from designer mockups, sustaining an 80% CTR on the homepage.
Managed e-commerce sites Indochina.lk, Findfast.lk and booking portal CityBook.LK.
Built and maintained WordPress sites with Elementor for clients, applying SEO for visibility.
Designed logos, banners and marketing images for client branding.
Improved UI and functionality of a WordPress site; built a companion mobile app using React Native WebView.
Developed and tested pages with HTML, CSS and PHP.
